title: Loss-Aware Synthetic Data Generation
summary: An experimental framework for a Trustworthy AI course project that generates and evaluates synthetic tabular data along a privacy-utility trade-off, using Adult/Census Income and ACSIncome (Folktables) datasets with baseline classifiers and privacy metrics. It uses SDV's GaussianCopulaSynthesizer, CTGANSynthesizer, and TVAESynthesizer, instantiated via SDV's SingleTableMetadata, to generate the synthetic candidate datasets that are then scored and selected.
evidence: src/lossaware/synthetic.py:59-70 instantiates GaussianCopulaSynthesizer, CTGANSynthesizer, and TVAESynthesizer from sdv.single_table using SingleTableMetadata.
